messages.subject: "Failed to load resource" errors crashing deployed RMarkdown with Shiny
parts:

I have a RMarkdown + Shiny document that works fine, and has been deployed to shinyapps.io behind an authenticated login fine too.

However today, the app goes grey just after deployment.  The error logs via shinyapps::showLogs() show nothing untoward, just the RMarkdown usual messages so I'm a bit stumped on how to fix it.

When I look at the javascript console I get these errors regarding server resources, that may be the issue?  Screenshot attached. 

The URL of the app is https://mark.shinyapps.io/IIHautomatedMonthly/

Thanks,
Mark
